title: 数据科学与机器学习项目集
summary: 该项目包含作者在Nodebook数据科学与机器学习项目中完成的真实项目，涵盖Python、机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式AI及AI代理，注重构建具备思考、规划与行动能力的智能系统。
summary_en: This project includes real-world projects completed in the Nodebook Data Science & Machine Learning program, covering Python, ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, and AI Agents, focusing on building smart systems that can think, plan, and act.
